articles.summary: Dame Carolyn Fairbairn will assume the role of non-executive Chair of HSBC UK Bank plc by the end of 1H26, subject to regulatory approval, replacing Dame Clara Furse.
articles.title: Dame Carolyn Fairbairn to be appointed chair of HSBC UK Bank plc

articles.summary: HSBC Holdings plc today announced David Rice will be appointed as HSBC’s first Chief AI Officer, effective 1 April.
articles.title: HSBC announces David Rice as its first Chief AI Officer
